readiness.hed: Fredericksburg sees a cold, sunny Tuesday near 54 with an overnight low around 27, holds dry and mild Wednesday near 55 before rain moves in Wednesday night, and arrives at a wet, windy Thanksgiving Thursday with a 100 percent chance of rain and a high near 64
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service shows no active watches or warnings for Fredericksburg this morning. Today is sunny and cold with a high near 54 and north winds gusting to 21 mph, followed by a clear, cold night down to around 27 — the week's coldest morning yet to come tonight. Wednesday stays dry and milder near 55 under partly sunny skies, but rain arrives Wednesday evening with a 90 percent chance of precipitation and gusts to 30 mph overnight. That system carries straight into Thanksgiving Day itself: NWS puts the chance of rain at 100 percent with a high near 64 but winds gusting to 37 mph and a slight chance of thunder, continuing into a wet, mostly cloudy Thursday night near 45.
actions: Tonight's low around 27 is the coldest night of the week so far — cover outdoor spigots, bring in sensitive plants, and check on elderly neighbors before bed.
Wednesday is the window to get outdoor Thanksgiving prep done — grocery runs, yard work, travel — before rain and gusty wind move in Wednesday evening.
Thanksgiving Day itself carries a 100 percent chance of rain with gusts to 37 mph — plan parking, decorations, and any outdoor cooking (turkey fryers) with a firm wet-weather backup.
If you're traveling Wednesday night or Thursday morning for the holiday, build in extra time; rain arrives right at the start of the heaviest travel window.
